summary: Covers viewing a product detail page, adding/removing it from the cart from that page, returning to the inventory listing, and repeated add/remove toggling.

cases.title: Viewing a product's detail page shows its name, description, and price
steps: Read the name, description, and price on the detail page
cases.expected: The detail page's name and price exactly match the product clicked, and a Back to products button is visible.

cases.title: Adding to cart from the detail page updates the button and badge
cases.expected: The button changes to Remove and the cart badge shows "1".

cases.title: Removing from the detail page reverts the button and clears the badge
preconditions: The product was just added to the cart
cases.expected: The button reverts to Add to cart and the cart badge is gone.

cases.title: Back to products returns to the full inventory listing
cases.expected: The inventory page is shown with all 6 products listed.

cases.title: The add/remove toggle is consistent across repeated use
cases.expected: After the second Add to cart, the button shows Remove and the badge shows "1" — the same end state as a single add, with no drift from the repeated cycle.
